finish.immersive_tanning.supple.descript: Worked loose for movement. Faster, harder to notice, and supple boots keep your steps from sculk.
finish.immersive_tanning.harness.descrip: Tensioned for hard use. Lasts much longer and patches best in the field.
finish.immersive_tanning.hardened.descri: Stretched taut and dried stiff. The best protection leather can give.

screen.immersive_tanning.fleshing.title: Fleshing a %s Hide
screen.immersive_tanning.fleshing.instru: Hold the mouse button and drag the knife through the flesh. Along the grain it comes off in one pass. Lift the knife between patches.
screen.immersive_tanning.fleshing.hint: Scrape along the grain lines. Scraping clean hide or slipping off the edge costs Integrity.
screen.immersive_tanning.fleshing.times_: Time's up - the hide is scraped as it is.
screen.immersive_tanning.fleshing.next: The scraped hide is in your inventory. Steep it in a Tanner's Vat.
screen.immersive_tanning.finish.title: How will you finish this leather?
screen.immersive_tanning.finish.keys: Click or press 1-3. Enter repeats your last finish.
screen.immersive_tanning.bench.choose: Click a piece to cut it
screen.immersive_tanning.bench.title: Stitching %s %s
screen.immersive_tanning.bench.instructi: The needle runs along the seam. Press once per stitch hole (click or Space) when its ring turns bright and the hole lights up. A press long before that does nothing; one just before it spoils the stitch.
screen.immersive_tanning.bench.press: One press per hole, when the ring turns bright
screen.immersive_tanning.bench.too_early: Too early - that press did not count. Wait for the bright ring.
screen.immersive_tanning.bench.next: The piece is in your inventory, with its offcuts as Leather Scraps.
jei.immersive_tanning.tannery_yield: Yields %s leather of the chosen finish
jei.immersive_tanning.finish_note: Choose Supple, Harness or Hardened when lacing the wet hide into the rack.
jei.immersive_tanning.leather_note: Any one finish; all leather in a piece shares a finish and trait.
jei.immersive_tanning.quality_note: Integrity comes from the leather, Workmanship from your stitching.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.rack: Mount a raw hide and use a Tanner's Knife to flesh it: drag the knife through the patches of flesh, along their grain. Later, lace a wet tanned hide into the frame and choose its finish; it dries by itself. Right-click the dry leather to collect it.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.vat: Fill with a bucket of water, add bark, and put in scraped hides (a whole stack at once). Each hide spends tannin by size and tans on its own clock, even while you are away. Use an empty hand to take out tanned hides; sneak with an empty hand to take back one that isn't done. Hoppers and pipes can supply and empty it. Comparators read how many hides are ready.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.bench: Use an Awl on the bench, choose a piece and the leather to cut it from, then stitch the seam in rhythm. Workmanship scales armor and the finish's effect; Integrity (from fleshing) scales durability.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.knife: Use on a log to strip its bark. Use on a raw hide mounted on a Tanner's Rack to flesh it.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.awl: Use on a Leatherworker's Bench to stitch. In the field, keep using it to patch your most worn leather piece with a Leather Scrap.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.bark: Stripped from logs with a Tanner's Knife. One bark is one tannin charge in a Tanner's Vat.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.scraps: Offcuts from the bench. Right-click scraps onto damaged leather in your inventory to patch it; an Awl must be in your inventory. Harness leather patches best.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.hide: Dropped by animals. Hides come in three sizes; a large hide yields three leather. Hides from some creatures keep an innate trait into the finished leather. Skins and pelts from other mods (a skinned carcass, a kangaroo hide) mount on the Tanner's Rack as raw hides too.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.leather_suppl: Supple - Light & Quiet. Each piece adds movement speed and shrinks the range at which mobs notice you; supple boots keep your footsteps from sculk.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.leather_harne: Harness - Rugged & Repairable. Much more durability, and field repairs restore twice as much.
jei.immersive_tanning.info.leather_harde: Hardened - Protective. Each piece adds armor and some toughness: the best protection leather gives, still lighter than iron.

jei.immersive_tanning.info.binding: Binding Leather replaces vanilla leather: every recipe, loot table and trade that used leather uses it instead. Cut it from any finished leather. Any vanilla leather you still hold converts one to one in a crafting grid. It cuts into three Leather Scraps.
